info.name: GPay Wallet System
info.description:
Postman collection for GPay Wallet System microservices.

Services:
- Auth Service: http://localhost:8081
- Wallet Service: http://localhost:8082
- Payment Service: http://localhost:8083
- Mock Gateway Service: http://localhost:8084

Usage:
1. Register a user via POST /auth/register
2. Login via POST /auth/login — access_token is auto-saved to the `access_token` variable
3. Use {{access_token}} in Authorization headers for protected endpoints
4. The collection automatically adds X-Trace-Id when a request does not define one explicitly

request.description: Register a new user. Returns 201 Created with user_id, email, and created_at. Password is never returned.
Expected: 409 Conflict with error EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED when email is already taken.
Expected: 400 Bad Request with error VALIDATION_ERROR when email format is invalid.
Expected: 400 Bad Request when password lacks uppercase, digit, or special character.
Login with email and password. Returns access_token (15 min) and refresh_token (7 days). The test script auto-saves both tokens to collection variables.
Expected: 401 Unauthorized with error UNAUTHORIZED.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token and refresh token (token rotation). The old refresh token is revoked. Tokens are auto-saved to collection variables.
Expected: 401 Unauthorized when refresh token is unknown, expired, or revoked.
